subject: Coffee & Tea
title: The First Coffee Drinks
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The First Coffee Drinks.

hook.text: Early coffee wasn't brewed like today. People chewed the beans or boiled the whole fruit in water.

buildup.text: Ethiopian tribes mixed crushed coffee berries with animal fat to make portable energy balls.

discovery.text: Qishr, a drink made from coffee husks and spices, predates the bean brew and is still enjoyed in Yemen.

twist.text: Roasting beans and grinding them for brewing likely started in Yemen around the 15th century.

climax.text: That simple shift—roast, grind, brew—created the drink that would conquer the entire world.

punchline.text: Chewed fruit became a world-conquering beverage.

quiz.question: What is qishr?
options: A drink made from coffee husks and spices
